title: Multiplicities of eigenvalues and quadratic representations of integers
summary: We study the set $M$ of all multiplicities of non-zero eigenvalues for the Laplace operator on a two-dimensional rectangle or torus. We show that for a rectangle with the side length ratio $r$, $M=\mathbb{N}$, the set of all positive integers, if and only if $r^2$ is rational. For a torus whose generating vectors have a length ratio $r$ and the angle between them $θ$, we show that $M$ is an infinite set if and only if both $r\cosθ$ and $r^2$ are rational.
